text: Sanborn has said the table on the sculpture is slightly different from the one he used. This tries every alphabet one swap or one move away from KRYPTOSABCDEFGHIJLMNQUVWXZ.
With A and B swapped, places 22 and 29 force R and W in the same slot: dead for a 7-letter word.
925 alphabets, repeating keys of every length to 52 and ciphertext autokey at every distance: survivors at the shuffled rate, and no word among 16,671 forced fragments.
